// Overlay this test into Interceptor's internal/snapshot package to regenerate
// fixtures with the native constructor, verifier and hash implementation.
package snapshot

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/digest"
)

func TestOperatorCheckpointFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	destination := os.Getenv("OPERATOR_SNAPSHOT_FIXTURE_DIR")
	if destination == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture output directory")
	}
	cp, err := NewCheckpoint("sess-1", "", digest.Bytes([]byte("environment")), digest.Bytes([]byte("application")), 9007199254740993, digest.Bytes([]byte("journal")), digest.Bytes([]byte("manifest")), 123, 7, "baseline <&>", "fixture", time.Date(2026, 9, 24, 12, 0, 0, 123456789, time.UTC), Metadata{CampaignID: "campaign-1", Description: "Before mutation — retain context"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cp.ID = "cp-1790251200000-0123456789abcdef01234567"
	for _, name := range []string{"checkpoint-v1.json", "checkpoint-legacy-v1.json"} {
		if name == "checkpoint-legacy-v1.json" {
			cp.CampaignID, cp.Description = "", ""
		}
		cp.Hash, err = checkpointDigest(cp)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = VerifyCheckpoint(cp); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		raw, err := json.Marshal(cp)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(destination, name), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
